children: PDS Biotechnology redeemed in full its promissory note with Yorkville on Sep 14, 2026, paying approximately $4.6 million to cover all outstanding principal and accrued interest. The $6.0 million note, issued on Jun 15, 2026 and amended on Aug 31, 2026, carried a 10% annual interest rate and was due Jun 15, 2027. The early termination incurred no penalties. The payoff reduces debt and interest expense ahead of schedule.
